why_no_activation_was_performed: No existing service is both correctly owned by StegVerse-Labs/.github and suitable as the long-lived SHWP process host.
The direct connected Render controls cannot create the required background-worker plus persistent-disk combination.
Reusing the LLM-adapter persistent disk or StegVerse-SCW worker would move canonical control-plane ownership into another subsystem.
Creating a stateless web service would not preserve heartbeat/registry/event/cost/receipt/checkpoint state across restart/deploy.
Creating or reusing a datastore alone would not make current file/repository mutation semantics durably restart-safe and would introduce an unproven provider-specific state adapter.
No paid resource was created without a separately established cost/authority basis.
release_condition: A correctly owned replaceable long-lived process host becomes available to StegVerse-Labs/.github.
Durable writable heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt and canonical-checkpoint state survives restart/deploy.
Runtime v8 owns internal heartbeat cadence; the host supplies process liveness only.
A restart proof preserves/increments the one heartbeat epoch and creates no duplicate claim/fence.
No ChatGPT automation, GitHub cron, Render cron or other external scheduler owns worker activation.
next_executable_action: Reinspect connected deployment controls when a correctly owned durable process-host capability or an already-admitted provider-neutral durable-state host becomes machine-observably available; then deploy v8 and run restart-continuity proof.
